# Melanie Dunn

> AI systems builder and marketing strategist based in Ohio. Designs, builds, documents, and operationalizes agentic AI systems for real cross-functional teams. Deep background in marketing operations, SEO/AIO, data infrastructure, and design.

Melanie Dunn is an AI systems architect and marketing operations strategist. She came up through design (20+ years), then marketing, then marketing operations, and now builds AI-powered workflow systems. Her work sits at the intersection of agentic AI, business process design, and marketing strategy.

She is the AI Systems & Marketing Operations Lead at Three Seven Marketing (B2B digital marketing agency, Ohio), where she builds internal AI tooling, client-facing agentic workflows, and reporting infrastructure. She also runs Melsplains, a content brand focused on AI and marketing for working moms, and consults independently on AI systems and marketing strategy.

## Featured Projects

**Pip** — Production AI project manager built on Claude Code. Multi-API architecture connecting Toggl, Monday.com, and Fireflies via a custom slash-command layer (/pm-status, /pm-sprint, /pm-plan, /pm-meeting, /pm-geekbot, /pm-report, /pm-mywork). Deployed team-wide via automated shell script. Reduced meeting-to-task workflow from 20 minutes to 20 seconds.
See: https://www.melaniedunn.work/work/pip.html

**Roux** — AI meal planning system built on Claude Code. File-based architecture (household profile, pantry inventory, weekly deals as local markdown files) with AnyList MCP integration, custom slash commands, and iOS Shortcut. Two-tier public release: Simple (claude.ai) and Build Your Own (Claude Code).
See: https://www.melaniedunn.work/work/meal-planner.html
